description: Patient-level clinical trial data including study and site identifiers, patient identifiers, demographic characteristics, consent/enrollment/procedure dates, randomization and cohort assignments, device implant details, withdrawal/death status, monitoring dates, and operational study contacts. No direct patient PII; patient identifiers are source-system subject IDs only.

STUDY.label: STUDY
STUDY.description: Sponsor/source-system study code identifying the clinical trial or registry record belongs to, such as CRD_1032, CRD_1003, or CRD_971. Used with SITE and PT/PT_LAST to associate the patient with the correct parent study.

STUDY_TITLE.label: STUDY_TITLE
STUDY_TITLE.description: Full study or registry title associated with STUDY, such as VANTAGE, SH Device Registry, ARIES HM3, or other trial names. Provides human-readable context for the study code.

SITE.label: SITE
SITE.description: Sponsor/source-system site code identifying the clinical trial site where the patient was consented, enrolled, implanted, followed, or screened, such as EU1883 or EU1957.

SITE_NAME.label: SITE_NAME
SITE_NAME.description: Name of the participating site, hospital, institution, or internal-use site associated with SITE.

CITY.label: CITY
CITY.description: City recorded for the clinical trial site.

STATE.label: STATE
STATE.description: State, province, region, or source-system geographic abbreviation for the clinical trial site.

COUNTRY.label: COUNTRY
COUNTRY.description: Country recorded for the clinical trial site.

PT.label: PT
PT.description: Patient/subject number within the study or site context. This is a source-system patient identifier, not a direct personal identifier.

PT_LAST.label: PT_LAST
PT_LAST.description: Composite patient/subject identifier or label, commonly combining site code and patient number, such as SITE-PT. Used as the row-level patient key in reporting.

PT_STATUS.label: PT_STATUS
PT_STATUS.description: Patient-level disposition/status flag summarizing subject state in the study. Values may be single or combined flags, for example enrolled/active, failed screening, withdrawn, deceased, or all-follow-up-complete indicators. Observed values: ALL; D; D ALL; F; F D; W; W ALL; W D; W D ALL.

PHYSICIAN.label: PHYSICIAN
PHYSICIAN.description: Investigator or treating/enrolling physician associated with the patient record, when available. This is professional contact/context information rather than patient PII.

GENDER.label: GENDER
GENDER.description: Patient sex/gender value as captured by the source study system. Values may use abbreviated or full-text coding depending on study/source. Observed values: F; FEMALE; Female; M; MALE; Male.

PT_AGE.label: PT_AGE
PT_AGE.description: Patient age at the relevant study baseline, screening, consent, or enrollment time point, depending on study conventions. Observed non-blank range in this file: -1 to 100.

NYHA_CLASS_ENR.label: NYHA_CLASS_ENR
NYHA_CLASS_ENR.description: NYHA functional class or heart-failure status at enrollment/baseline. Values include NYHA classes and study-specific no-heart-failure or not-determined values. Observed values: CLASS II; CLASS IIIA; CLASS IIIB; CLASS IV; I; II; III; IV; IV (AMBULATORY); IV (NON-AMBULATORY); NO HEART FAILURE; NO HF; NOT ASSESSED; NOT DETERMINED; NOT DONE; UNK.

TO_CHAR(P.CONSENT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.CONSENT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.CONSENT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date the patient signed informed consent or consent was recorded, formatted by the source SQL extract as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

CONSENT_REV.label: CONSENT_REV
CONSENT_REV.description: Informed consent form revision/version used for the patient consent, often including revision letter, version number, date, and/or country/language suffix. Observed values include 1041 distinct non-blank values; examples: 01 AUGUST 2017; 01-12-2016; 01.OCT.2015 VERSION F; 01/10/17; 01/10/2017; 01/12/2016; 03 AUGUST 2015; 03-21-2017; 03-22-2016; 03-AUG-2015; 03/10/2017; 03/21/2017; 03/21/2018; 03/22/2017; 03AUG2015; 03JUN2016; 04 MAY 2016; 04-11-2017; 04APR2017; 04APR2017 VERSION J.

PROT_REV.label: PROT_REV
PROT_REV.description: Protocol revision/version applicable to the patient record at consent, notification, enrollment, or procedure, depending on study workflow. Observed values: 1; A; A (28JUL2021); A_20Mar2025; A_RU; B; B_26Jun2025; B_RU; C; CIP VERSION B; C_05DEC2023; C_05Dec2023; D; D_26AUG2024; E; ED; F; G; H; K; SOUTH AMERICA VERSION A; South America Version A; VERSION B; VERSION C; VERSION E; Version E.

TO_CHAR(P.NOTIF_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.NOTIF_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.NOTIF_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Patient notification date from the source system, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated. Used by some studies to track notification or source workflow milestone timing.

TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date the patient was enrolled or formally entered into the study, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

TO_CHAR(P.IMP_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.IMP_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.IMP_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date of device implant, index procedure, ablation, or relevant study procedure, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

SYST_REV_FG.label: SYST_REV_FG
SYST_REV_FG.description: System revision flag captured for applicable device studies. Indicates whether a system revision occurred or was applicable for the patient. Observed values: Y.

RAND_CONFIG.label: RAND_CONFIG
RAND_CONFIG.description: Randomization configuration, assignment process, or study-specific randomized configuration value used for the patient when applicable. Observed values: APPROVED, PENDING RANDOMIZATION; APPROVED, TERMINATED PRIOR TO RANDOMIZATION; CONTINUED ACCESS STUDY (CAS); CONTROL; EXISTING; INTERMEDIATE; LOW; MEDICAL THERAPY (CONTROL) GROUP; N; NEW; RANDOMIZED; ROLL-IN; SCREEN FAILURE; TREATMENT; TRICLIP DEVICE (DEVICE) GROUP; Y.

RAND_ARM.label: RAND_ARM
RAND_ARM.description: Randomization arm or assigned treatment/control group for randomized studies. Used to distinguish randomized device, control, drug/therapy, or study-group assignments. Observed values: AMULET; CAV; CONTROL; Control Group - 65% Fixed Tilt; DEVICE; ESPRIT BTK; FIXED DELAY; IN-CLINIC; MEDICAL THERAPY (CONTROL) GROUP; MITRACLIP DEVICE (CONTROL) GROUP; MITRACLIP DEVICE (DEVICE) GROUP; MITRAL VALVE REPAIR SURGERY (CONTROL) GROUP; NAVITOR; NOAC; PORTICO; PTA; RANDOMIZED AMULET; RANDOMIZED ARM; RANDOMIZED CONTROL; ROLL-IN AMULET; SINGLE ARM; Study Group - Fixed Pulse Width; SYNCAV; TENDYNE DEVICE (DEVICE) GROUP; TREATMENT; TRICLIP DEVICE (DEVICE) GROUP; VIRTUAL.

DEVICE_TYPE.label: DEVICE_TYPE
DEVICE_TYPE.description: Device type, therapy type, implant category, or product family associated with the patient record, such as AMULET, NOAC, PROCLAIM DRG, or other study-specific device/therapy categories. Observed values: ASSERT-IQ TM INSERTABLE CARDIAC MONITOR; CLIP; ETERNA SCS; IPG; LEAD; LVAD; N; PROCLAIM DRG; PROCLAIM ELITE 5; PROCLAIM ELITE 7; PROCLAIM IPG 5; PROCLAIM XR; PRODIGY; PRODIGY MRI; VALVE; Y.

PG_MANUF.label: PG_MANUF
PG_MANUF.description: Pulse generator manufacturer recorded for cardiac rhythm/device studies, when applicable. Observed values: ABBOTT; ABBOTT/SJM; BIOTRONIK; BOSTON SCIENTIFIC; LIVANOVA; MEDTRONIC; OTHER; SJM/ABBOTT; UNKNOWN.

PG_MODEL.label: PG_MODEL
PG_MODEL.description: Pulse generator model recorded for cardiac rhythm/device studies, when applicable.

PG_SERIAL.label: PG_SERIAL
PG_SERIAL.description: Pulse generator serial number recorded for cardiac rhythm/device studies, when applicable.

DEVICE_MODEL.label: DEVICE_MODEL
DEVICE_MODEL.description: Model or size identifier for the study device, implant, or comparator device used for the patient, when applicable.

DEVICE_SERIAL.label: DEVICE_SERIAL
DEVICE_SERIAL.description: Serial number or unique device identifier for the implanted or study device, when captured by the source system.

TO_CHAR(P.WD_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.WD_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.WD_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Withdrawal, discontinuation, screen-failure, or study-exit date for the patient, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

WD_REASON.label: WD_REASON
WD_REASON.description: Reason the patient withdrew, discontinued, screen-failed, was lost to follow-up, died, or otherwise exited study participation. Observed values include 161 distinct non-blank values; examples: ABORTED PROCEDURE PRIOR TO FLEXABILITY SE INSERTION; ABORTED PROCEDURE PRIOR TO TACTIFLEX PFA CATHETER INSERTION; ABORTED PROCEDURE PRIOR TO VOLT PFA INSERTION; ABORTED PROCEDURE, TACTIFLEX PFA CATHETER INSERTED BUT NO RF OR PF ENERGY; CLINICAL INVESTIGATION DISCONTINUED BY THE SPONSOR; CONSENTED SCREEN FAILURE; CONSENTED, NO TREATMENT ATTEMPTED; DEACTIVATION; DEATH; DEVICE EXPLANT; DEVICE EXPLANTED; EARLY TERMINATION OF THE CLINICAL TRIAL; EXPIRED; EXPLANTED; FAILED BOTH RANDOMIZATION AND SINGLE ARM CRITERIA; FAILED INCLUSION OR EXCLUSION CRITERIA AFTER SIGNING INFORMED CONSENT; HEART TRANSPLANT; IMPLANT NOT ATTEMPTED; IMPLANT/PROCEDURE WITH STUDY DEVICE CANCELED; IMPROPER/DUPLICATE SUBJECT ENROLLMENT.

DEATH_FG.label: DEATH_FG
DEATH_FG.description: Flag indicating whether the patient death indicator is recorded for the patient. Observed values: Y.

IMPLANT_TYPE.label: IMPLANT_TYPE
IMPLANT_TYPE.description: Study-specific implant or procedure type, such as new implant, replacement, system upgrade, de novo implant, initial procedure, or index ablation procedure. Observed values: 12M; 30D; ARTERIOVENOUS; ARTERIOVENOUS - E; ARTERY; ARTERY - E; ASD; CAS; DE NOVO IMPLANT; IDE; IMPLANT; INDEX ABLATION PROCEDURE; INITIAL; INITIAL PROCEDURE; INSERTION; LINE_EXTENSION; N; NAVITOR JAPAN; NEW IMPLANT; P1_AMP_4V; P1_AMP_ASD_PFO; P1_AMP_PDA; P2_AMP_PDA; PFO; PHASE II; PIVSD; RE-ATTEMPT; REATTEMPTED IMPLANT; REPLACEMENT; SINGLE; SURGERY; SYSTEM UPGRADE; VEIN; VEIN - E; VISTA NOVA; VSD; Y.

TO_CHAR(P.DEATH_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.DEATH_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.DEATH_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Patient death date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated and applicable.

OLD_SITE.label: OLD_SITE
OLD_SITE.description: Prior site code or migrated legacy site value, when a patient/site was transferred or converted from an earlier source-system site identifier.

FCE.label: FCE
FCE.description: Field clinical engineer or field clinical contact associated with the patient/site record, when available.

CRA_NAME.label: CRA_NAME
CRA_NAME.description: Clinical research associate assigned to the patient/site/study record, when available.

PT_TRANS_FG.label: PT_TRANS_FG
PT_TRANS_FG.description: Patient transfer flag indicating whether the patient was transferred between sites or source-system contexts, when populated.

PT_GROUP_VALUE.label: PT_GROUP_VALUE
PT_GROUP_VALUE.description: Patient group, cohort, analysis population, visit grouping, follow-up cohort, or study-specific classification assigned to the patient. Observed values include 96 distinct non-blank values; examples: 12_MONTH; 12_MONTH_PA; 30_DAY; 30_DAY_D; 6_MONTH_CA; 6_MONTH_PA; ALIVE; ALIVE_E; AMPLATZER; ANALYSIS - NG; ANALYSIS - TITAN; ANALYSIS-INTERMEDIATE RISK; ANALYSIS-LOW RISK; B; CALA MECHANICAL; CALA TISSUE; CONTINUED ACCESS STUDY (CAS); CRT-D; DE NOVO (DUAL CHAMBER LP INDICATION); DE NOVO (SINGLE CHAMBER ATRIAL LP INDICATION); DE NOVO IMPLANT; EASE; EMEA MECHANICAL; ENROLLMENT; EXISTING CONTROL; EXISTING HM3; EXISTING NO-RAND; EXTENSION COHORT; Extreme; FEASIBILITY SUB-STUDY; FLEXNAV ANALYSIS COHORT; FLEXNAV ROLL-IN; GROUP 1; GROUP 1; GROUP 3; GROUP 1; GROUP 4; GROUP 1; GROUP 5; GROUP 2; GROUP 4; GROUP 5; High; ICD; INTERMEDIATE; LINE_EXTENSION; LOW; MAC; MAC CAP; MAIN STUDY; N; NEW HM3; NEW NO-RAND.

WEIGHT.label: WEIGHT
WEIGHT.description: Patient weight value captured at the relevant baseline, enrollment, procedure, or study-specific time point. Observed non-blank range in this file: 1 to 960.

WEIGHT_UNIT.label: WEIGHT_UNIT
WEIGHT_UNIT.description: Unit of measure for WEIGHT, such as KG or LB. Observed values: G; KG; Kg; kg; LB; LBS; lbs.

TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_RECV_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_RECV_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_RECV_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date enrollment documentation or enrollment data was received/recorded by the source workflow, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

TO_CHAR(P.MON_TRIGGER_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.MON_TRIGGER_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.MON_TRIGGER_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Monitoring trigger date or date used to initiate monitoring/workflow activities for the patient record, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

RETROSPECTIVE_FG.label: RETROSPECTIVE_FG
RETROSPECTIVE_FG.description: Flag indicating whether the patient record is retrospective or prospectively captured according to the study/source workflow. Observed values: N; Y.
